issues.failure_explanation: The change of variables $\widetilde{\vec{x}} = \vec{B}^{1/2}\vec{x}$ combined with the preconditioned system $\vec{B}^{-1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{-1/2}\widetilde{\vec{x}} = \vec{B}^{-1/2}\vec{b}$ and the substitution $\vec{p} = \vec{B}^{-1/2}\widetilde{\vec{p}}$ yields $\vec{p}^0 = \vec{B}^{-1}\vec{r}^0$, contradicting the stated PCG formula $\vec{p}^0 = \vec{B}\vec{r}^0$. The correct change of variables is $\widetilde{\vec{x}} = \vec{B}^{-1/2}\vec{x}$, giving preconditioned matrix $\vec{B}^{1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{1/2}$. Consequently the identity $\mathrm{cond}_2(\vec{B}^{-1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{-1/2}) = \mathrm{cond}_{\vec{A}}(\vec{B}\vec{A})$ is false; the correct identity is $\mathrm{cond}_2(\vec{B}^{1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{1/2}) = \mathrm{cond}_{\vec{A}}(\vec{B}\vec{A})$, since $\vec{B}^{1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{1/2}$, $\vec{A}^{1/2}\vec{B}\vec{A}^{1/2}$, and $\vec{B}\vec{A}$ all share the same eigenvalues whereas $\vec{B}^{-1/2}\vec{A}\vec{B}^{-1/2}$ does not.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace B^{-1/2} with B^{1/2} (and vice versa) in the change of variables, the preconditioned matrix B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2}, the identity eq: condition numberfor PCG, and the preconditioned matrix expressions in the two corollaries. The PCG iteration formulas and all mathematical conclusions (contraction, condition number bounds, optimality) remain correct.
issues.overall_effect: The derivation of the PCG iteration formulas from the preconditioned system is internally inconsistent. The condition number identity is false, so the reduction step bounding cond_2 of the preconditioned matrix via cond_A(BA) in the proofs of Corollary corollary: symmetric MG optimality and Corollary theorem: AS condition number bound is invalid. The preconditioned matrix expressions (B^SMG)^{-1/2}A(B^SMG)^{-1/2} and (B^AS)^{-1/2}A(B^AS)^{-1/2} in these corollaries are wrong.
issues.title: Wrong sign of exponent in preconditioned matrix and condition number identity
issues.why_classification: The repair is a consistent sign change in the exponent of B^{±1/2} across several formulas. It is short, local, and routine; it preserves every substantive claim and guarantee (contraction factors, condition number bounds, optimal complexity) with no new lemma, construction, or replacement argument needed.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Employ Dörfler marking to determine a set $\MM_{\ell} \in \M_{\ell}[\theta, u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}]$

issues.failure_explanation: The Dörfler marking set is defined with $u_{\ell}^{\star}$ (the unknown exact discrete solution) on the right-hand side of the marking criterion instead of $u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}$ (the computed approximate solution). The algorithm step instructs the user to select $\MM_\ell$ from this set, but $u_\ell^\star$ is unavailable at run time, so the algorithm is not implementable as stated. The standard Dörfler marking uses the same computable approximation $u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}$ on both sides of the inequality.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $u_{\ell}^{\star}$ with $u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}$ in the definition of $\M_{\ell}[\theta, u_{\ell}^{\underline{k}}]$ in step (ii) of Algorithm algo: AFEM, yielding the standard Dörfler marking set. All results then apply directly.
issues.overall_effect: Algorithm algo: AFEM cannot be executed as written. The optimality claim of Theorem thm: optimal complexity for this algorithm is unsupported because the marking set does not match the standard Dörfler marking assumed in the referenced optimality proofs (GHPS21, BFMPS23).
issues.title: AFEM marking set uses unknown discrete solution instead of computable approximation
issues.why_classification: The correction is a single symbol replacement that makes the algorithm implementable and aligns the marking set with the standard Dörfler criterion used in the optimality analysis. Every substantive claim and guarantee is preserved with no new argument required.
